test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven girls G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6 and G7 are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). G6 is second to the left of G1. G7 is second to the left of G6. G5 is third to the right of G2. G5 is not the immediate neighbour of G6. G4 is third to the right of G3.

Who is second to the left of G7?
solution:
Given: Seven girls G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6 and G7.

1) G6 is second to the left of G1.

2) G7 is second to the left of G6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5737eb51dde8ac68c5b52fa9ff7abe7ea78992c36e5b48f250c55465a58a7369.png] 

3) G5 is third to the right of G2.

4) G5 is not the immediate neighbour of G6.

5) G4 is third to the right of G3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa82d92df3cdbf17ad55b2615315602211843cfa0686fa734befcdaa4e55f161.png] 

G3 is second to the left of G7.

Hence, the correct answer is **"G3"**.
